questions.q: ISRO is planning to set up a third launch pad at which location within the next four years?
questions.explain: Sriharikota, a barrier island in Andhra Pradesh, serves as the location of the Satish Dhawan Space Centre, ISRO’s principal facility for orbital launches using PSLV and GSLV vehicles.
